newsitem.title: CHINA: SWIRE SEES ENHANCED PROPERTY PROFITS.
newsitem.headline: SWIRE SEES ENHANCED PROPERTY PROFITS.

text.p: Swire Pacific Ltd said on Thursday it expected further enhancement of property profits during the second half of 1997, due to the sales of residential development properties and growth in net rental income.

It said operating profits at Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd were expected to be higher in the second half of the year due mainly to seasonal factors and profits from Hong Kong Aircraft Engineering Co (HAECO) to be broadly in line with 1996.
"The results from operations of the remaining divisions are expected to improve in the second half-year," Swire said in a statement.
The Hong Kong conglomerate posted interim net profit of HK$3.32 billion compared with HK$3.06 billion in the equivalent period of last year. -- Hong Kong newsroom (852) 2843 6345
